fashionChoices.detail: the grey, severe; the evening, kept.

fashionChoices.label: Rose, at rest
fashionChoices.detail: the wrapper, soft; the vigil, eased.

fashionChoices.label: The night's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the dark judges the vigil.

scenes.synopsis: the garden, in the dark — the past, quiet; per door.
scenes.prose:
> *(From the bedroom window the walled garden lies in the dark, and the past — no new face, only the old sin — lies quiet in it tonight. If she chose bury: the mason's lantern moves along the wall where the gap was, and the gap is already less of a wound, stone on stone. If she chose expose or atone: the gap stands open to the night, the wall down where the papers came out, and the dark sits in it like something waiting to be told what it is now.)*
> *(Rosemary grows black against the wall. The garden, in the dark. The past, quiet.)*

scenes.synopsis: the light, still burning — the aunt, awake; the cracking, unheard.
scenes.prose:
> *(She passes Letitia's door on her way down, and the candle is burning under it — the quartermaster not yet abed. She stops. Inside, the smallest sounds: a drawer opened, closed; a drawer opened again, closed more firmly, as if the drawer had offended. Then nothing. Rose stands in the dark hall with her hand half-raised to the door, and does not knock. The confession, whatever it is, is not tonight's. The silence is load-bearing, and she will not be the one to bring the house down.)*
> *(She goes on down the stairs. The candle burns on behind her. The aunt, awake. The cracking, unheard.)*

scenes.synopsis: the sting — the printed word arrives in the night; the hunters' proof, Pounce's sheet, Bell's draft.
scenes.prose:
> *(The sting comes near ten at night, and it is the printed word arriving in the night. If she chose expose: it is the Lash's Monday special in proof, intercepted from the Lash's office — the accomplice's story set in type, the lie dressed for Monday while the truth is still on the road. The blade not yet hers; the wound, aimed at Monday's breakfast tables. If she chose bury: it is Pounce's Monday leader, intercepted from the Lash's office — prizefights and a parson's debts, the four lines starving for want of feeding, Saturday's issue and nothing more. The purchase, dead of hunger. If she chose atone: it is Bell's draft of the trust's notice — the sin and the payment set side by side in type, the account and the founding together. "The Gazette," Bell has written, "doesn't print halves.")*
> *(Rose reads it once, by candlelight, and sets it with the Lash's old issues and the trust's paper: the drawer, the archive of the reckoning, filling. The printed word, arrived. The reckoning, in type.)*
scenes.sting: the sting — the printed word arrives in the night; the hunters' proof, Pounce's sheet, Bell's draft.

scenes.synopsis: the posting — the watch, set for the night; the drive, still empty.
scenes.prose:
> *(The clock nearing ten, and the night's order holds as given. Amos is at the gates with the lantern; the second man waits at the lodge with the relief trimmed for midnight's change. The drive is empty all the way to the village. Nothing has come up it all evening but the mason's cart, and nothing will till morning — the Gazette boy's return, or the mason's third course at seven, or the trust's first accounting, whichever Monday brings.)*
> *(The lantern holds its ground on the drive. The watch, set. The evening, guarded.)*

scenes.synopsis: the archive's Monday — the claret, laid out for the morning.
scenes.prose:
> *(In the bedroom, laid across the chair for the morning, is the archive's answer to whatever Monday brings: deep claret silk, twenty-five years old and re-cut twice, the skirt's embroidery a shade darker than the stuff. Letitia laid it out without being asked — "If the town is reading about us," she will say in the morning, "the town can read claret." The mended gloves wait beside it. The grandmother's pearls. Tonight it is only cloth on a chair. In the morning it will be armor.)*
> *(Rose touches the skirt's embroidery, a shade darker. The claret, laid out. Monday, dressed in advance.)*

fashionChoices.label: Wear it openly
fashionChoices.detail: the claret; the week, faced in full dress.

fashionChoices.label: Dress it down
fashionChoices.detail: plain morning dress; the household, unruffled.

fashionChoices.label: Leave it to morning
fashionChoices.detail: the hour decides.

scenes.synopsis: the house, at rest — the last act, found in the morning; per the decision.
scenes.prose:
> *(The house makes its last sounds, and the last act is there to be found in the morning. If she chose the memorandum: the book lies closed on the desk, the evening entered — the figures, the watch's order, the morning's plan — the night's record kept in Octavia's precise hand and her own. If she chose the garden: her boots stand by the door, dark with the garden's damp, and the walled garden's path holds one set of footprints to the wall and back. If she chose the candle: the morning room's candle burns on, the vigil's light kept for whoever could not sleep — and in the morning, the stub will show it burned till three.)*
> *(Three different traces, one vigil. The house, at rest. The act, kept.)*

scenes.synopsis: the vigil's pause — the woman, steady before ten; the logistics, done.
scenes.prose:
> *(She sits a while in the bedroom with the dried violet at her wrist and does the logistics of the night to come: the mason's third course at seven, or the Gazette's reading by eleven, or the trust's first accounting — the figures, the post, the watch's changing at midnight, each item placed where Monday can find it. The ledger of the evening, balanced. And underneath the logistics, unsaid, the image she would never speak aloud: the walled garden in the dark, the gap in the wall like a mouth closed around a secret, or opening to tell it.)*
> *(She sets the dried violet in water on the sill. The logistics, done. The image, kept. She goes down to the hall for ten.)*

scenes.synopsis: the cliffhanger — ten o'clock's approach; the mason's stone, the boy's road, the post's seals.
scenes.prose: > *(The evening's last minute. If she chose bury: the mason's trowel taps once more in the dark — a stone set true by lamplight, the wall's second course rising, the third by seven. If she chose expose: the road to town lies dark and empty, and Bell's boy has not yet returned — the sealed account still riding somewhere between the Park and the proprietor's desk, the evening holding its breath around it. If she chose atone: the London post's seals are pressed and cooling on the study desk, the trust's first letters waiting for the morning coach — payment, begun, going out into the world. She stands in the hall, and the clock gathers itself to strike. Ten is coming.)*

scenes.synopsis: ten o'clock — the night's second hour; the house, past the vigil's start.
scenes.prose:
> *(Ten strikes in the hall, and the house changes its key the way a good house does: without announcement. The lamps burn lower on the landings. The kitchen has gone from its second sitting to its clearing. Somewhere the gates' far creak, then the dark again. She stands in the hall and listens to ten settle into the walls, the way she stood at seven and listened to the choosing. The choosing was the door. This is the hour after it, and the hour has the hunters' smell on it.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the boy is still on the road to town, the sealed account riding in his coat, whole and untrimmed, in her own hand. If she chose bury: the mason's lantern moves along the wall, and the second course is going up in the dark. If she chose atone: the clerk's pen scratches in the study, the deed copying fair, and the seal's wax waits by the candle. Three labors, one hour. She stands in the hall a moment longer, listening. The house sounds awake.)*

scenes.synopsis: the vigil, undressed — the slate's company face set aside; the night's private hour.
scenes.prose:
> *(At ten she takes the vigil's company face off the way one takes off gloves. The slate silk stays, the archive's answer to the night, but the long rope of pearls is coiled into its case, the silver rose pin laid beside it, and the hair comes down from its pins into a plait, the way it has gone since she was seventeen. In the glass the woman the household doesn't see: paler without the pearls, and steadier for it.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the town will read her on Monday, and the dressing had better read steady. If she chose bury: the secret stays kept, and the dressing keeps it. If she chose atone: ten years of accountings wait, and the dressing had better last. Whatever the door, the undressing is the same: severe, deliberate, her own. The plait, tied. The vigil, private.)*

fashionChoices.label: Rose, unpinned
fashionChoices.detail: the hair, down; the night, her own.

fashionChoices.label: Rose, severe
fashionChoices.detail: the slate, kept on; the hour, faced.

fashionChoices.label: Élise's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the modiste judges the private hour.

scenes.synopsis: the letter — a woman's hand; the orders, changed; the reload's instrument.
scenes.prose:
> *(In London the night is an hour older, and Slade reads by a better lamp. The letter came at nine, by a boy who would not say from whom, and the hand on the direction is a woman's, formed and unhurried, the letters standing like small soldiers. He reads it twice. The first reading is for the instructions. The second is for what the instructions cost him: Sunday's deadline is spent, the waiting is over, and his principal's patience has gone the way of all patience that was ever only money.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the new orders are to print first, the gutter's version on Monday ahead of Bell's Monday, the accomplice's story before the account. If she chose bury: the new orders are to find what burned, the grandfather's letters, the mason's loose stones, Harrow's memory, bought or taken. If she chose atone: the new orders are to spoil the paying, the trust's forty-one thousand six hundred made to sound like hush money, the ledger dirtied in print. In every door the last line is the same, in the woman's formed hand: no more waiting. The purse that came with the letter is fresh, and heavy. The reload, ordered.)*

scenes.synopsis: the quiet — Mrs. Quick's people, gone silent all at once; the village, careful.
scenes.prose:
> *(Élise finds her in the hall with the village in her mouth, the way she always has it: whole, warm, and exact. "Mrs. Quick's people," she says, "have gone quiet." She counts it off on her fingers. "The Crown's taproom, careful. Mrs. Pike's counter, closed early, and her with a headache she never had before. The blacksmith's boy, won't say who asked him about the mason's hours." She looks at Rose. "All at once, Miss Hartwell. Villages don't go quiet in chorus unless somebody has asked them to.")*
> *(If she chose expose: the quiet is the hunters learning the account rides to Bell, and closing ranks around the lie they mean to print first. If she chose bury: the quiet is the hunters learning the papers are ash, and listening for what remains. If she chose atone: the quiet is the hunters learning the trust pays, and pricing the smear. In every door the shape is the same: the eyes have been told to stop watching and start working. The village, careful. The quiet, decided.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE RELOADING: how Rose answers the hunter's new orders.
scenes.prose:
> *(Ten o'clock, and the reload is no longer a feeling. It is a letter in a woman's hand, a fresh purse, a village gone careful all at once. Three answers offer themselves. Warn the household: tell them plainly, the watch doubled, the eyes open, the cottage guarded, the gates held like the week before, the house armed against the reloading, because quiet is information and the house has earned its armor. Keep the quiet: say nothing, let the household have its Sunday night, the week was long and the reload can keep till morning, mercy to the house, because a household cannot stand siege forever. Follow the money: put Henry on the draft and watch what the fresh purse buys, Quill's instruction standing, watch the spending not the silence, the money telling where the new orders point.)*
> *(She stands in the hall with the lamps lit and the village careful outside it, and thinks: the choosing was the door, and the door is chosen. This is the first night of living in it armed.)*
> *(She answered the reloading the way she had answered the choosing: deliberately, and once. Whatever it was, the warning, the quiet, the money, the household took it up, or was spared it, or set Henry to it, the way the hall takes up everything. The reload, answered.)*

options.label: Warn the household
options.detail: *Resolve+; the house, armed.* Tell them plainly; double the watch; the eyes open. *(Quiet is information; the house, armored.)*

options.label: Keep the quiet
options.detail: *Mercy+; the house, spared.* Say nothing; let the household have its night. *(The week was long; the siege, postponed.)*

options.label: Follow the money
options.detail: *Candor+; the spending, watched.* Henry on the draft; watch what the purse buys. *(The money tells; the orders, exposed.)*

scenes.synopsis: the trace, begun — Pounce's £100, and where it came from.
scenes.prose:
> *(Henry begins the way he begins everything: with the paper, in order. Pounce's £100, the price of the four lines, paid and banked, came to the Lash's office not as coin but as a banker's draft, and the draft is drawn on a London factor. He lays it on the study desk under the lamp: the factor's engraved border, the sum in the clerk's careful hand, and on the back the endorsements, three of them, three different hands, each an initial and a flourish, each a man the money passed through on its way from whoever paid it to whoever printed with it.)*
> *(Rose looks at the three sets of initials. "Cutouts," Henry says. "The money changed coats twice before it reached Pounce. The factor's books will name the depositor." He stops. "The factor's books open in the morning. Not tonight." The trace, begun. The money, mid-journey.)*

scenes.synopsis: the money's coats — what the endorsements say, and what they withhold.
scenes.prose:
> *(They read the draft's back together, the way people read a letter they both know is lying. The first endorsement is dated Thursday, the day the two thousand was offered and refused, in writing, by nightfall. The second is dated Friday. The third, Pounce's own banker's mark, is Saturday. "Thursday's money," Henry says, "bought Saturday's issue. Whoever paid it knew the offer would be refused before the offer was made.")*
> *(If she chose expose: the money meant to buy the sin is now buying the gutter's version of the truth, the accomplice's story printed first. If she chose bury: the money meant to buy the papers is now buying the search for what burned. If she chose atone: the money meant to buy the silence is now buying the smear of the paying. In every door the lesson is the same, and Henry says it: "The purchase failed. The purchaser did not." The coats, counted. The wearer, unnamed.)*

scenes.synopsis: the re-arming, seen — Slade's people, at work; the new orders, executed.
scenes.prose:
> *(Slade's second man brings the report at half past ten, and it is the reload made visible. The agents' lodgings, the rooms the village pretends not to know, have new luggage in them and new orders on the table: Slade's purse, opened; his second man's wages, doubled; a boy sent to London with a sealed packet for Pounce's office. The stranger at the Crown has closed his notebook and paid his shot. The eyes that watched the gates all week have been stood down, and the hands have been hired.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the packet for Pounce is the gutter's Monday special, the accomplice's story set before Bell's Monday truth. If she chose bury: the packet is the search's instructions, the mason's men, the grandfather's letters, Harrow's memory, priced. If she chose atone: the packet is the smear's first line, the forty-one thousand six hundred made to sound like hush money. In every door the execution is the same: the watching is over, the working has begun. The lodgings, lit. The reload, staffed.)*

scenes.synopsis: the quartermaster, slipping — the household book; the wrong column; the crack, widening.
scenes.prose:
> *(Letitia sits in the morning room with the household book, and the quartermaster's hand is not the quartermaster's hand. She enters the mason's hours in the wrong column, the kitchen's, not the garden's, and stares at the entry a full minute before she sees it. She takes the penknife to the page, scrapes the ink out, writes it again in the right column. The corrected entry is blotted. She looks at the blot a moment, then shuts the book with a snap that is not quite the quartermaster's snap, too hard, too final, the snap of a woman shutting something else.)*
> *(Rose, from the door, says nothing. Whatever the door, the account riding, the wall rising, the trust paying, the aunt's cracking is the same: the shape she knew, pressing at the edges of the silence that kept the family's peace. The book, shut. The crack, widening.)*

scenes.synopsis: the blacks, at ten — the quartermaster's night dress, re-seen; the lace, loosened.
scenes.prose:
> *(At ten the quartermaster's blacks show the night. The bombazine, twenty years old, sits heavier on her than it did at dinner; the collar's lace, her one concession, has been loosened a button, the only disorder Rose has ever seen her permit herself. The cuffs are fastened. The brooch is straight. But the loosened lace says what the cuffs won't: the woman inside the uniform is awake, and the uniform is the only thing holding her upright.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the town will read the shape she kept silent, and the lace is loosened against the reading. If she chose bury: the silence is kept, and the lace is loosened against the keeping. If she chose atone: the shape is paid for, and the lace is loosened against the price. Whatever the door, the dressing is the same: the quartermaster, at ten, coming undone one button at a time. The lace, loosened. The aunt, showing.)*

fashionChoices.detail: the cuffs, fastened; the night, managed.

fashionChoices.label: Letitia, loosened
fashionChoices.detail: the lace, undone; the woman, showing.

fashionChoices.label: Rose's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the niece judges the uniform.

scenes.synopsis: the second hour of the labor — stone, road, or pen; the choosing, worked on.
scenes.prose:
> *(The night's labor goes into its second hour. If she chose bury: the mason's lantern moves along the wall where the gap was, and the second course is nearly complete, stone on stone in the dark, the trowel's tap, the mortar's clean smell reaching the garden door. If she chose expose: the road to town lies dark and empty, and the boy is still out, the sealed account riding somewhere between the Park and the proprietor's desk, whole and untrimmed, in her own hand. If she chose atone: the clerk's pen scratches on in the study past half past ten, the deed copying fair, the keeping, the trust, the creditors named, and the seal's wax waits by the candle.)*
> *(Rose stands at the garden door, or the hall window, or the study's threshold, and watches the door she chose being worked by other hands. The labor, seconded. The choosing, carried.)*

scenes.synopsis: the gates' second hour — the porter, the lantern, the London road.
scenes.prose:
> *(Amos walks the gates' second hour with the lantern, and the drive is empty all the way to the village. He has held these gates through four lines and a stranger and an offer of three thousand pounds, and he holds them tonight against something he cannot see: the reload, the re-arming, the quiet that is a decision. Rose walks down with him as far as the lodge, and they stand a minute in the dark the way they stood at nine, two Hartwell people, saying nothing that needs saying.)*
> *("All quiet, Miss Hartwell." "All quiet, Amos." But the quiet is not the same quiet as nine o'clock. At nine it was the night resting. At half past ten it is the night holding its breath. The lantern swings. The gates, held.)*

scenes.synopsis: the heir, in the garden — the black coat, the dark path; the card, unwritten.
scenes.prose:
> *(From the hall window she sees him in the walled garden, the black coat, the hands in the pockets, the young man's back to the house, the same as nine o'clock and different. He has stopped at the wall's gap, where the papers came out, and he stands looking at it the way a man looks at a place where something of his was buried. He does not look up. The card he may write in the morning's post is not written; whatever it will say, staying, going, the twelve hundred as debt, tonight he is only the heir of a ruin, walking.)*
> *(If she chose expose: his mother's name will be in every sheet by Monday, told true, and the garden path is where he is learning to carry it. If she chose bury: his mother's name stays out of the papers, and the garden path is where he is learning what that costs. If she chose atone: the twelve hundred is debt, named and paying, and the garden path is where he is learning to be a creditor. Whatever the door, the walking is the same: spare, alone, his. She does not call to him. The garden, his. The heir, walking.)*

scenes.synopsis: the evidence, kept — Henry's drawer; Slade's letters, filed; the refusal, in writing.
scenes.prose:
> *(In the study Henry's evidence drawer lies open under the lamp, and the week's paper is all in order: Slade's first letter, the two thousand, offered Thursday, refused in writing by nightfall, laid beside Slade's last, the three thousand, the final offer, refused Sunday, the hunters' final offer. The refusal, in Rose's hand, between them. The final offer, dead. The draft from the factor, new tonight, on top. Rose stands in the doorway and does not interrupt the ordering; some rooms are chapels, and the study at half past ten is one.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the drawer holds the account's fair copy, waiting for the morning's reading of what the boy carried. If she chose bury: the drawer holds the ash's record, the burning witnessed, the wall's order. If she chose atone: the drawer holds the trust's founding, sealed and public, the first payment entered. Whatever the door, the drawer is the same: the week's truth, filed. The evidence, kept.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 2/3 — THE AUNT: what Rose does about Letitia's cracking.
scenes.prose:
> *(Half past ten, and Letitia is coming undone one button at a time, the wrong column, the loosened lace, the too-hard snap of the book. She knew the shape, never the names or sums, and the silence kept the family's peace for twenty years. Three answers offer themselves. Ask her plainly: sit her down in the morning room, say the "Rose, I—" for her, and hear whatever comes, candor to the woman who kept the house, because the crack is widening and a crack ignored becomes a break. Give her the night: the load-bearing silence, honored, don't touch it, don't knock, let the confession keep till its own hour, mercy to the aunt, because some silences hold up the whole house and this is one. Hold her to the house: give her the morning's orders, keep her in the work, the quartermaster's duty as the splint, because the household needs its quartermaster and Letitia has never once failed an order.)*
> *(She stands in the hall with the aunt's candle burning somewhere above her, and thinks: the choosing was the door, and the reloading is the night. This is the family, inside both.)*
> *(She chose for the aunt the way she had chosen for the house: deliberately, and with love in hand. Whatever it was, the asking, the night, the duty, Letitia would receive it the way she receives everything, as an order, or a mercy, or a question, and answer in kind. The aunt, answered.)*

options.detail: *Candor+; the question, asked.* Sit her down; say the sentence for her; hear it. *(The crack, faced before it breaks.)*

options.label: Give her the night
options.detail: *Mercy+; the silence, honored.* Don't touch it; let the confession keep. *(The house stands; the hour, hers.)*

options.label: Hold her to the house
options.detail: *Resolve+; the quartermaster, kept.* The morning's orders; duty as the splint. *(She has never failed an order.)*

scenes.synopsis: the hall, hearing — Alice, the kitchen fire; the reload, felt below stairs.
scenes.prose:
> *(Below stairs the reload is felt the way weather is felt: in the talk's temperature. Alice sets the night's bread to rise and listens with half an ear to the second sitting's low voices, the Crown's taproom gone careful, Mrs. Pike's counter closed early, the mason's men fed and saying nothing about the wall's hours. "They've gone quiet up at the lodgings," someone says, and the hall goes quieter, the way a hall does when it has just named the thing it was circling.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the hall knows the boy is on the road, and the talk is of Monday's reading. If she chose bury: the hall knows the wall is rising, and the talk is of the third course at seven. If she chose atone: the hall knows the trust pays, and the talk is of ten years. Whatever the door, the hall's answer is the same: the orders are clear, the night is staffed, and whatever the hunters reload, the house is already loaded, stitch by stitch, the way it does everything. The hall, hearing. The reload, felt.)*

scenes.synopsis: the draft's back — the last endorsement; the thread, not the name.
scenes.prose:
> *(Henry reads the draft's back once more, by the study's best lamp, and finds what the first reading missed: the last endorsement before Pounce's banker's mark is in a clerk's practiced hand, initials, a flourish, and a date, Friday, and the paper's watermark is the factor's own. "The factor issued it himself," Henry says. "Not a customer's draft. The house's own paper. Whoever holds the factor's books holds the name." He looks up. "And the books are in the City, and shut till morning.")*
> *(Rose thinks of Friday: the day the money moved, the day after the two thousand was refused in writing, by nightfall, the refusal carried to the house in Letitia's hand. The money moved the same day the offer died. "Not tonight," Henry says, and folds the draft away. The thread, held. The name, not tonight's.)*

scenes.synopsis: the fresh money — what the new orders buy; the reload, funded.
scenes.prose:
> *(In London Slade opens the fresh purse, and the reload gets its price. His second man's wages, doubled, paid down on the table. The boy to Pounce's office, paid for the packet and the speed. The lodgings' rent, a month in advance, because the watching is over and the working needs a roof. He counts it out the way a man counts ammunition, carefully, and with respect for what it will do.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the money buys the gutter's Monday special, ink, paper, the compositor's overtime, the accomplice's story set before Bell's Monday truth. If she chose bury: the money buys the search, the mason's men's loose talk, the grandfather's letters, Harrow's memory, priced by the hour. If she chose atone: the money buys the smear, the trust's forty-one thousand six hundred dressed as hush money, the creditors' gratitude bought off, the ledger dirtied in print. In every door the spending is the same: the purchase failed, and the purchaser is buying again. The purse, opened. The reload, funded.)*

scenes.synopsis: the crack, deepening — the morning room, alone; the line, crossed out.
scenes.prose:
> *(She finds Letitia in the morning room, alone, with a sheet of the household paper before her, not the book, a letter. The pen is in her hand and the page holds three lines, and as Rose watches from the door, her aunt reads the three lines, takes the pen, and crosses them out, once, hard, the nib nearly tearing the paper. She folds the crossed sheet, unfolds it, folds it again, and puts it in the drawer with the household's old letters, where it will sit like a stone in a shoe.)*
> *(Rose does not ask what the three lines said. Whatever the door, the truth riding, the wall rising, the trust paying, the aunt's letter is the same: the shape she knew, trying to get itself written, and the twenty years' silence crossing it out. She backs out of the doorway without a sound. The letter, unwritten. The crack, deepening.)*

scenes.synopsis: the modiste's night — Élise's errand dress; the village's news, carried in the posy.
scenes.prose:
> *(Élise comes at eleven with the night's posy, and the errand has its own dress: the modiste's black silk, twenty years old and cut like a uniform, the white apron folded over her arm, the basket of dried violets and rosemary on top, faithfulness and remembrance, the season's two truths, carried up the stairs. "The village," she says, setting the posy where the choosing's bowl stood, "has stopped talking, Miss Hartwell. So I brought flowers instead. Flowers," she adds, "are harder to buy.")*
> *(If she chose expose: the posy is for the house that will be read on Monday, dressed steady. If she chose bury: the posy is for the house that keeps its secret, dressed quiet. If she chose atone: the posy is for the house that pays for ten years, dressed to last. Whatever the door, the modiste is the same: warm, exact, unbuyable. The posy, set. The errand, dressed.)*

fashionChoices.detail: the mistress judges the errand.

scenes.synopsis: the night's letters — the wax, the signet; the morning coach, loaded.
scenes.prose:
> *(At eleven she seals the night's letters herself, in the study, with the signet and the red wax. The estate's ordinary business, the mason's account, the kitchen's orders, a note to Quill's clerk about the deed's fair copy, sealed and stacked for the morning coach. Nothing in them the agents could use; she reads each one twice before the wax, the way she has read everything all week.)*
> *(If she chose expose: one letter more, a line to Bell's office, confirming the boy's errand and the account's seal, in case the road is less kind than the plan. If she chose bury: one instruction more, the mason's third course at seven, the kitchen door, the men's breakfast. If she chose atone: one order more, the trust's first letters, the creditors' names, the seal's red wax on the founding's copies. Whatever the door, the sealing is the same: the wax, the signet, the press of her own hand. The post, loaded.)*

scenes.synopsis: the ordinary, as armor — the Harringtons, the fire, the choosing absorbed.
scenes.prose:
> *(In the drawing room the fire is built up and the talk has settled into its Sunday-night shape: the Harringtons' eldest on the runaway gig, told better than it was at dinner; somebody's aunt quoted at length; the choosing sitting among them like a dog that has been walked and fed. Augusta holds the best chair in the sapphire velvet, the pearls loose, the ebony cane across her knees, and contributes exactly one dry remark an hour, on schedule.)*
> *(When the talk brushes the reload, the Crown's quiet, the lodgings' lamps, it brushes it the way the hall brushes everything: carefully, and with ownership. If she chose expose: the talk is of Monday's reading, and the house's steadiness under it. If she chose bury: the talk is of the wall's third course, and the house's quiet under it. If she chose atone: the talk is of ten years, and the house's patience under it. Whatever the door, the ordinary is the same: the armor the house wears indoors. The fire, built up. The talk, holding.)*

scenes.synopsis: the friends' late hour — the trace, read together; Quill's instruction, kept.
scenes.prose:
> *(Octavia finds her after the post is sealed, with the memorandum book and the night's second arithmetic. She reads Henry's draft findings in pencil-light silence, the factor's own paper, the three hands, the Friday date, and nods once, the way she nods at sums that balance. "The money changed coats twice," she says. "Quill's instruction stands: watch the spending, not the silence. Whatever the new purse buys, the gutter's ink, the mason's talk, the smear, we will see it bought.")*
> *(If she chose expose: the spending to watch is Pounce's Monday special, the accomplice's story set before the truth. If she chose bury: the spending to watch is the search, loose stones, loose talk, loose memories. If she chose atone: the spending to watch is the smear, the paying dressed as hush money. Whatever the door, the friends' doctrine is the same: the hunter reloads in money, and money leaves tracks. The book, entered. The late hour, kept.)*

scenes.synopsis: the witness's light — Harrow's cottage, the guard's fire; the keeping, seen.
scenes.prose:
> *(She walks as far as the garden gate and looks down the path to Harrow's cottage, the way she has looked all week. The cottage lamp burns, the schoolmaster reads late, or does not sleep, and the guard's fire is lit in the lean-to, the second man's pipe glowing as he walks his round. Whatever the door, the keeping is the same: no one touches him, no one buys him, no one prints him. The guard stays. She said it in the morning room before them all, and the night is keeping her word for her.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the town will call him the accomplice for a week, and the guard is the house's answer. If she chose bury: the quiet is kept, and the guard is the quiet's price. If she chose atone: the deed is copying fair, and the guard is the deed's honor. Whatever the door, the light is the same: the witness, kept. She turns back to the house. The path, dark. The cottage, lit.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — THE WITNESS'S KEEPING: the night's order against the reload.
scenes.prose:
> *(Half past eleven, and the reload has its shape now: the letter, the purse, the packet to Pounce, the village gone careful. One order remains before the small hours, the witness's keeping, against whatever the re-armed operation tries next. Three orders offer themselves. Double the guard: nobody sleeps unguarded, the cottage guard doubled, the gates held, the lamps lit on every landing, the choosing's night staffed like the week before, because the hunters are working now and working men try doors. Send Henry at dawn: the draft's factor, the City books, the three hands, finish the trace, ride to London with the morning coach and read the factor's books when they open, because the money will name the wearer and the name is the weapon. Rest the household: the week was long, the reload can keep till morning, the house to bed and the vigil kept by two, because a household cannot stand siege forever, and Monday will be full.)*
> *(She stands in the hall with the lamps turned low and the cottage lit down the path, and thinks: the choosing was the door, the reloading was the night, the aunt was the family. This is the keeping, the last order of Sunday.)*
> *(She gave the last order of Sunday the way she had given the first: plainly, and once. Whatever it was, the doubling, the ride, the rest, the household took it up without a murmur, the way the hall takes up everything, as an order it had already given itself. The keeping, ordered.)*

options.detail: *Resolve+; the cottage, the gates.* Nobody sleeps unguarded; the night, staffed. *(The hunters try doors; the doors, held.)*

options.label: Send Henry at dawn
options.detail: *Candor+; the trace, ridden.* The City books; the money, named. *(The name is the weapon; the ride, ordered.)*

options.label: Rest the household
options.detail: *Mercy+; the house, gentled.* The week was long; the night, kept by two. *(Monday will be full; the house, rested.)*

scenes.synopsis: the quiet, unnerving — the Crown, Mrs. Pike's, the blacksmith; nobody, talking.
scenes.prose:
> *(At half past eleven the village is dark in a way that is not Sunday's ordinary dark. The Crown's windows are shuttered early, the taproom's light gone. Mrs. Pike's counter is closed, the shop blind down. The blacksmith's forge is cold. And in the agents' lodgings, the rooms the village pretends not to know, the lamps are lit, all of them, the windows bright against the dark street like a hand of cards laid face up.)*
> *(Rose hears it from the second man, and stands at the hall window looking toward the village she cannot see. If she chose expose: the bright windows are the gutter's Monday special being set. If she chose bury: the bright windows are the search being planned. If she chose atone: the bright windows are the smear being written. Whatever the door, the meaning is the same: the quiet was the reloading, and the reloading is done. The village, dark. The lodgings, lit.)*

scenes.synopsis: the trace, reported — incomplete; the thread, held for morning.
scenes.prose:
> *(Henry makes his report at a quarter to twelve, standing, the way he stands for things that aren't finished. The factor's books are in the City and shut till morning. The three hands on the draft's back are initials and flourishes, no names. The last endorsement is Friday's, the day after the two thousand died in writing. "Not tonight, Miss Hartwell," he says. "The money changed coats twice, and the last coat is hanging in a counting-house that opens at nine.")*
> *(If she chose expose: the trace would tell her whose money buys the gutter's Monday special. If she chose bury: the trace would tell her whose money buys the search. If she chose atone: the trace would tell her whose money buys the smear. Whatever the door, the report is the same: the thread is held, the name is not tonight's. She nods. Some hunts wait for the banker's hours. The report, made. The morning, tasked.)*

scenes.synopsis: the friend's night — Octavia's precision, off duty; the shawl, the plain silk.
scenes.prose:
> *(Octavia at a quarter to twelve is a study in the precision at rest. The memorandum book is closed, the night's arithmetic entered, the sums loved and left. Her dress is the friend's plain dark silk, the shawl pulled close against the study's chill, the pencil behind her ear like a quill that forgot its century. "The sums," she says, catching Rose's eye, "are done being counted. The rest of the night is yours to spend unmeasured.")*
> *(If she chose expose: the friend priced the telling, and the price is riding to Bell. If she chose bury: the friend priced the keeping, and the price is ash. If she chose atone: the friend priced the paying, and the price is ten years. Whatever the door, the friendship is the same: the courage to name the cost, and then to sit with it, unmeasured, in the small hours. The shawl, close. The friend, at rest.)*

fashionChoices.detail: the book, closed; the night, accounted.

fashionChoices.label: Octavia, softened
fashionChoices.detail: the shawl, close; the hour, unmeasured.

fashionChoices.detail: the mistress judges the friend.

scenes.synopsis: the new orders, executed — the packet, the ink, the search; the reload, at work.
scenes.prose:
> *(In London the new orders are executed before midnight. The boy is back from Pounce's office with the receipt for the packet, the Lash's compositor paid his overtime, the Monday special's ink ordered. His second man's wages are doubled and his instructions changed: no more watching the gates, now the mason's yard, the grandfather's letters, the schoolmaster's cottage. Slade burns the woman's letter in the lodgings' grate and watches the formed hand curl, the orders in his head now, and the head paid for.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the Monday special is the accomplice's story, Harrow's name, the sums, the lie set before the truth. If she chose bury: the Monday work is the search, the wall's loose stones, the letters, the memory, bought. If she chose atone: the Monday work is the smear, the forty-one thousand six hundred, the trust, the paying made to look like buying. In every door the execution is the same: the watching is over, the working has begun, and the principal's money is moving. The letter, burned. The reload, at work.)*

scenes.synopsis: the Night's Arming ritual — the house arms itself in fashion; the chapter's ritual.
scenes.prose:
> *(System: commit to a direction, A, B, or C, then twenty 5-coin pins. 20 pins × 5 coins = 100 coins. Re-picks always free; the jewel shelf stays open and is never a ritual step.)*
> *(Story morsel: the dressing — per door. Expose: the account riding to Bell; the house dresses for a week of being read, and being read first by the gutter. Bury: the wall's second course rising in the dark; the house dresses around the secret it carries, and the search for it. Atone: the trust paying, the deed copying fair; the house dresses for the smear, and outlasts it. Whatever the door, the arming's face is the same: severe, deliberate, unafraid.)*
> *(Story morsel: the posting — the watch posted per the night's order. Amos at the gates with the lantern till midnight, the second man after; the cottage guard doubled, or the household at rest, or Henry's ride readied for dawn, as ordered. The house that chose does not meet the reload unarmed.)*
> *(Story morsel: the keeping — the house settling around the choice, against the reload. The drawing room's fire built up; the servants' hall at rest; Letitia's candle still burning under her door; Laurent's path in the garden dark. The night holds them all, and asks nothing.)*
> *(Story morsel: the night's middle — per door. Expose: the road to town dark, the boy still out, the gutter's Monday special setting in type. Bury: the mason's lantern at the wall, stone on stone, the search's money moving in London. Atone: the clerk's pen in the study, the deed copying fair, the smear's first line being written. Three labors, one reload.)*
> *(Story morsel: the small hours' approach — the house nearly asleep except the watch. The memorandum closed, or the garden walked, or the candle burning, as she chose at ten. The arming is done. Midnight waits past the dark, punctual as ever.)*

ritual.occasionBrief: The hunter has reloaded — the letter, the purse, the packet to Pounce, the village gone careful. The house answers the only way it knows: it dresses for the night it is in. The vigil's second hour is armed and ordered: the watch posted, the lamps lit, the money watched, the doors held. Walk the night in the ritual's order — the dressing, the posting, the keeping. Exact. Quiet. Deliberate. The house that chose does not meet the reload unarmed.

scenes.synopsis: eleven, toward twelve — the house, awake into the small hours.
scenes.prose:
> *(Midnight nears, and the house goes with it into the small hours' country. The lamps burn low on the landings. The drawing room's fire is banked. The study's lamp is out, Henry's candles snuffed, the draft folded away for morning. Somewhere the kitchen cat; somewhere a shutter; somewhere in the village a dog barks once, at the lodgings' bright windows, and thinks better of it.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the road to town is dark, and the boy is still out with the sealed account. If she chose bury: the wall's gap is less of a wound, and the mason's lantern is out. If she chose atone: the deed is half fair-copied, and the clerk sleeps in the study chair. Whatever the door, the middle of the night is the same: the house asleep except the watch, the reload staffed, and the house knowing it. The night, deepened. The watch, awake.)*

scenes.synopsis: the aunt, awake — the candle, the drawer; the crack, at its widest, unconfessed.
scenes.prose:
> *(She passes Letitia's door near midnight, and the candle is still burning under it, the quartermaster awake, the way she was at the vigil's start. She stops. Inside, the smallest sounds: the drawer opened, the folded letter taken out, the folded letter put back. A breath. Then, so quiet it is almost not a voice: "Rose—" The name hangs in the dark hall like a coat on a hook. Nothing follows it. The drawer closes, firmly, the way it closed at the vigil's start, as if the drawer had offended.)*
> *(Rose stands with her hand half-raised to the door, and does not knock. The confession, whatever it is, is not tonight's, the shape she knew pressing at the silence, and the silence holding. Not yet. She goes on down the stairs. The candle burns on behind her. The aunt, awake. The crack, at its widest, unconfessed.)*

scenes.synopsis: the vigil's hour — the wrapper, the glass; the woman, at eleven.
scenes.prose:
> *(Near midnight she is in the wrapper, the dove grey silk, the white stitching, the night's own color, and the vigil has eased into its last hour without asking her leave. The slate is folded over the chair. The plait is down. The dried violet stays at her wrist, faithfulness, the one ornament the night permits. In the glass the woman of the reloading's night: grey, quiet, unadorned, and, she is surprised to find, unbowed.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the grey will face Monday's reading, steady as the slate was. If she chose bury: the grey will keep the secret, quiet as the wall is. If she chose atone: the grey will attend ten years of paying, patient as the ledger is. Whatever the door, the glass shows the same: the house's mistress, at the small hours, dressed for whatever the reload brings. The wrapper, worn. The night, nearly kept.)*

fashionChoices.detail: the grey, severe; the night, kept.

fashionChoices.label: Rose, unbowed
fashionChoices.detail: the wrapper, soft; the reload, faced.

fashionChoices.label: The night's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the dark judges the vigil.

scenes.synopsis: the garden, near midnight — the past, quiet; per door.
scenes.prose:
> *(From the bedroom window the walled garden lies near midnight, and the past, no new face, only the old sin, lies quiet in it still. If she chose bury: the mason's lantern is out, and the second course stands complete in the dark, the gap less of a wound, stone on stone. If she chose expose or atone: the gap stands open to the night, the wall down where the papers came out, and the dark sits in it like something that has been told what it is now, and is considering.)*
> *(Rosemary grows black against the wall. The reload does not reach the garden; the garden is older than the hunters, and will be here when their money is gone. She watches it a moment, and the watching steadies her. The garden, near midnight. The past, quiet.)*

scenes.synopsis: the sting — the reload, in print; the night's last arrival.
scenes.prose:
> *(The sting comes near midnight, and it is the reload arriving in print. If she chose expose: it is an express from Bell's office, the boy not yet back, but the proprietor's warning ahead of him, "Your hunters are printing for Monday. Read it," and with it a proof of the Lash's Monday special, the accomplice's story set in type, the lie dressed for the town before the truth. If she chose bury: it is Pounce's Monday leader, intercepted from the Lash's office, prizefights and a parson's debts, the four lines starving still, Saturday's issue and nothing more, the purchase dead of hunger a second night. If she chose atone: it is Bell's note, the trust's notice set in type, the sin and the payment side by side, "the Gazette doesn't print halves," and under it, in the proprietor's blunt hand, "The Lash prints Monday too. Watch the spending.")*
> *(Rose reads it once, by candlelight, and sets it with the week's paper: the drawer, the archive of the reckoning, filling. The printed word, arrived. The reload, in type.)*
scenes.sting: the sting — the reload, in print; the night's last arrival.

scenes.synopsis: the changing's approach — near midnight; Amos's hour, nearly done.
scenes.prose:
> *(Nearing midnight, Amos's hour is nearly done, and the second man waits at the lodge with the lantern trimmed. The drive is still empty all the way to the village. Nothing has come up it all night but the mason's cart, and nothing will till morning, the boy's return, or the third course at seven, or the trust's first accounting, whichever Monday brings. Amos stamps the cold off his boots in the lodge, and the two men nod at each other, the way men nod who have held the same gates through four lines and a stranger and an offer of three thousand pounds.)*
> *(Whatever the door, the account riding, the wall rising, the trust paying, the changing is the same: the lantern passed hand to hand, the night guarded into its last hour. Rose watches from the hall window as the second man takes the lantern out. The changing, nearly done. The night, guarded.)*

scenes.synopsis: the last sounds — the night's order, executed; the reload, answered.
scenes.prose:
> *(The house makes its last sounds, and the night's order is there to be found in the morning. If she warned the household: the watch is doubled, the cottage guard two men, the gates held, the lamps lit on every landing, the house awake in shifts against the reload. If she kept the quiet: the house is at rest, and only the necessary lamps burn, Amos and the second man keeping the vigil between them, the choosing's night undisturbed. If she followed the money: the study's evidence is ordered for the morning, the draft folded, the factor's direction copied fair, Henry's bag packed for the coach, and then, the lamps out, the house to bed.)*
> *(Three different traces, one answered night. Whatever the reload brings at midnight, it finds a house that chose first, and chose again at ten. The house, at rest. The order, kept.)*

scenes.synopsis: the night's last dressing — the vigil's face, at midnight's approach; the flower, kept.
scenes.prose:
> *(At midnight's approach she looks once more at the vigil's face in the glass, and the glass gives it back plainly: the wrapper, the plait, the dried violet at the wrist, the woman who chose at ten and answered at half past eleven. The mended gloves lie on the dressing table, the mend at the thumb catching the candlelight like a signature. She sets the dried violet in water on the sill, faithfulness, keeping its color in the dark, and turns down the lamp.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the face the town will read on Monday is ready. If she chose bury: the face that keeps the secret is ready. If she chose atone: the face that will pay for ten years is ready. Whatever the door, the dressing is done: severe, deliberate, her own. The lamp, turned down. The vigil, nearly kept.)*

fashionChoices.detail: the night, faced; the glass, armor.

fashionChoices.label: Rose, softened
fashionChoices.detail: the dried violet, bright; the hour, held.

fashionChoices.label: The dark's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the small hours judge the vigil.

scenes.synopsis: midnight's approach — the logistics, done; the reload, weighed.
scenes.prose:
> *(She sits in the bedroom with the dried violet in water on the sill and does the logistics of the small hours: the watch's changing at twelve, the boy's road or the wall's third course or the trust's first accounting at seven, Henry's ride or the factor's books at nine, the London post on the morning coach. Each item placed where Monday can find it. The ledger of the night, balanced.)*
> *(And underneath the logistics, unsaid, the weighing she would never speak aloud: the letter in the woman's hand, the fresh purse, the packet to Pounce, the bright windows in the dark village. The hunter has reloaded. But the house chose first, at ten in the morning room, and again at ten at night, and whatever Monday costs, it costs less than the alternative. The alternative was the hunters' timetable. She chose the house's. The logistics, done. The reload, weighed.)*

scenes.synopsis: the cliffhanger — midnight; the lantern, passed; the reload, visible.
scenes.prose: > *(Midnight. In the lodge the lantern passes from Amos's hand to the second man's, and the watch changes, the night guarded into its last hours. And as the new watch takes the drive, the village answers: in the agents' lodgings, the rooms the village pretends not to know, three new lamps flare in windows that were dark at eleven, the reload, lit and working, while the house sleeps. The night holds its breath around it.)*

scenes.synopsis: midnight, kept — the watch changed; the house, past the reloading's night into the weighing's.
scenes.prose:
> *(Midnight strikes in the hall, and the house takes it the way it takes everything: in order. The lantern has passed from Amos's hand to the second man's at the lodge, and the drive is empty all the way to the village, where the agents' lodgings burn all three lamps against the dark. The house is asleep except the watch, Harrow's guard, and three people who have business with the small hours.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the road to town lies dark, and the boy is still out with the sealed account. If she chose bury: the wall's second course stands complete, and the mason's lantern is out. If she chose atone: the clerk sleeps in the study chair, and the deed is half fair-copied. Three labors, one midnight. She stands at the hall window and counts the lodgings' lamps: three. The reload, working. The weighing, begun.)*

scenes.synopsis: the wrapper, at midnight — the vigil's third dressing; the night, unpinned and unafraid.
scenes.prose:
> *(At midnight she is in the wrapper, the dove grey silk, the white stitching, the night's own color, and the third dressing of the vigil is the plainest: the slate folded over the chair, the plait down and loose, the dried violet at her wrist, faithfulness, the one ornament the night permits. The mended gloves lie on the dressing table, the mend at the thumb catching the candlelight. In the glass the woman of the weighing's night: grey, quiet, and done with being afraid of letters.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the grey will be read on Monday, and the dressing reads steady. If she chose bury: the grey keeps the secret, and the dressing keeps it. If she chose atone: the grey will attend ten years, and the dressing will last. Whatever the door, the glass shows the same: the mistress, at midnight, dressed for the reckoning. The wrapper, worn. The fear, set down.)*

fashionChoices.label: Rose, watchful
fashionChoices.detail: the grey, kept; the weighing, faced.

fashionChoices.label: Rose, unwound
fashionChoices.detail: the plait, loose; the hour, allowed.

fashionChoices.label: The lamp's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the light judges the vigil.

scenes.synopsis: the arithmetic, at midnight — Octavia's reading of the changed orders; the principal's intent, first priced.
scenes.prose:
> *(Octavia comes to the morning room with the memorandum book open and the night's third arithmetic. She has been adding Slade's new orders the way she adds everything: in columns. "He has stopped paying for eyes," she says, "and started paying for hands. The watching is over. The wages are doubled, the packet is sent, the letter is burned. A principal who pays twice for hands is a principal who has decided the waiting costs more than the doing.")*
> *(If she chose expose: the hands are setting the gutter's Monday special, the accomplice's story ahead of the truth. If she chose bury: the hands are pricing the search, the stones, the letters, the memory. If she chose atone: the hands are writing the smear, the paying dressed as buying. In every door the column is the same: the purse is fresh, the patience is spent, and "no more waiting" is not a temper. It is a budget. The book, entered. The intent, priced.)*

scenes.synopsis: the reading, at midnight — Henry's reading of Slade's handling; what the burned letter implies.
scenes.prose:
> *(Henry stands in the study with his hands behind his back, the way he stands when the law is the only company. "The letter is burned," he says. "The orders live in Slade's head now. There is nothing to find, and that is the finding. A principal who writes in her own hand and then has it burned is preparing to deny everything, and the denial is the plan.")*
> *(He looks at the evidence drawer, the week's paper in order. "The two thousand was an offer, made and refused. This is neither. A fresh purse and new orders at nine o'clock on a Sunday night is a principal who has stopped buying outcomes she can't control and started buying the men who can deliver them. She means to finish it." He stops. "Whatever it is." The law, stated. The handling, read.)*

scenes.synopsis: the working night — Slade past midnight; the orders in his head; the hand, burned but legible in memory.
scenes.prose:
> *(Past midnight in London Slade sits with the new orders the way a man sits with a new coat: settled into them. The woman's letter is ash in the lodgings' grate, but the hand is still legible in his head, formed and unhurried, the letters standing like small soldiers, and the last line under them: no more waiting. The purse is lighter by his second man's doubled wages, the boy's packet money, the month's rent paid in advance. The money has done its first night's work.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the work is the Monday special in type, the compositor paid his overtime, the accomplice's story set. If she chose bury: the work is the search's first prices asked, the mason's yard, the grandfather's letters, the schoolmaster's keeping. If she chose atone: the work is the smear's first line, the trust's forty-one thousand six hundred made to sound like hush money. In every door the night is the same: the watching over, the working begun, the principal's patience spent and the principal's money moving. The hand, burned. The orders, kept.)*

scenes.synopsis: the friend, past midnight — Octavia's precision, unpinned; the sums, loved and left.
scenes.prose:
> *(Octavia past midnight is the precision at rest. The memorandum book is closed on the third arithmetic, the pencil behind her ear, the shawl pulled close against the morning room's chill. Her dress is the friend's plain dark silk, unadorned, and she wears the hour the way she wears everything: exactly. "The sums," she says, "are done being counted. The rest of the night is for the weighing, and the weighing is not arithmetic.")*
> *(If she chose expose: she priced the telling, and the telling rides. If she chose bury: she priced the keeping, and the keeping stands. If she chose atone: she priced the paying, and the paying waits for morning. Whatever the door, the friend is the same: the courage to name the cost, and the grace to set the book down. The shawl, close. The friend, unpinned.)*

fashionChoices.label: Octavia, precise
fashionChoices.detail: the book, closed; the weighing, exact.

fashionChoices.label: Octavia, softened
fashionChoices.detail: the shawl, close; the hour, unmeasured.

fashionChoices.label: Rose's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the mistress judges the friend.

scenes.synopsis: the cost, to her — what a woman's hand on that paper costs Rose to consider; the mirror, unnamed.
scenes.prose:
> *(Alone, past midnight, she does the weighing she would never say aloud. A woman wrote that letter. Not a clerk, not a factor, not a husband's instruction copied fair: a woman's formed hand, unhurried, the letters upright and exact, and a purse that does not flinch behind them. Rose has never met her. She knows her exactly.)*
> *(The cost of the knowing is this: the principal writes her own orders. So does Rose. The principal pays men to do what she will not wait for. Rose has paid men all season. The principal's patience went the way of patience that was only money. Rose's own patience has a price too, and she has paid it, lamp by lamp, since ten. The mirror is the thing she cannot afford to look at straight, so she looks at it the way one looks at the sun: in water, in passing, in the dried violet's small reflection.)*

scenes.synopsis: the working night, seen — the lodgings' lamps; the village, dark around them.
scenes.prose:
> *(Past midnight the village is dark in the way of a village that has decided to sleep through something. The Crown's windows are shuttered. Mrs. Pike's blind is down. The blacksmith's forge is cold. And in the agents' lodgings, the rooms the village pretends not to know, the three lamps burn on, bright against the dark street, and behind the glass the shapes of men at work, the reload's night shift, the principal's money doing what money does at midnight: buying the morning.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the morning being bought is Monday's special, the lie set before the truth. If she chose bury: the morning is the search, the loose stones, the loose talk. If she chose atone: the morning is the smear, the paying dressed as buying. Whatever the door, the lamps are the same: the work, visible. The village, dark. The weighing, lit.)*

scenes.synopsis: the aunt, at quarter past twelve — the morning room; the pen, dry; the crack, widening.
scenes.prose:
> *(She finds Letitia in the morning room at quarter past twelve, and the quartermaster's post is deserted. The household book lies open, the pen beside it, the ink gone dry in the nib. Letitia sits with her hands in her lap, looking at the page she has not written on, and when Rose comes in she says, without looking up, "Your grandfather never wrote a letter himself. Someone always wrote for him.")*
> *(Rose says nothing. The silence holds a moment, and then Letitia looks up, and the look is the crack widening in real time: the shape she knew, pressing at the twenty years' silence that kept the family's peace. "Go to bed, Letitia," Rose says. "In a minute," Letitia says, and does not move. The book, open. The pen, dry. The aunt, awake.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE HAND: how the three treat the unknown principal; name, spare, or answer.
scenes.prose:
> *(Past midnight, and the weighing has its shape: the formed hand, the fresh purse, the changed orders, the burned letter, the last line under it all — no more waiting. Three answers offer themselves. Name it: say aloud what the hand implies, a woman, deliberate, done with waiting, the inference spoken between the three of them, candor to the night, because the unspoken costs more than the spoken. Spare it: don't speculate, don't hunt a woman the house cannot see, mercy to the three of them, because the hand is unknown and the guessing will eat the night. Answer it: set her own hand against it, the night's orders written in her own formed letters, the house's reply, because a principal who writes is answered in writing.)*
> *(She stands in the morning room with the memorandum closed and the draft folded and the lamps low, and thinks: the choosing was the door, the reloading was the night, the weighing is the reckoning. This is the hand, met.)*
> *(She chose for the hand the way she had chosen for the night: deliberately, and once. Whatever it was, the naming, the sparing, the answering, the three took it up the way they take up everything, as a reading, or a mercy, or an order, and the weighing went on. The hand, met.)*

options.label: Name it
options.detail: *Candor+; the inference, spoken.* Say what the hand implies; the three of them, plain. *(The unspoken costs more.)*

options.label: Spare it
options.detail: *Mercy+; the guessing, refused.* Don't hunt what the house can't see; the night, kept. *(The unknown, unchased.)*

options.label: Answer it
options.detail: *Resolve+; the reply, written.* Her own hand against it; the house's answer. *(A writer, answered in writing.)*

scenes.synopsis: the trace, held — the factor's books shut till nine; the name, Monday's.
scenes.prose:
> *(Henry folds the draft away in the study, and the folding is the trace's whole sermon: the factor's books are in the City and shut till morning, the three hands are initials and flourishes, no names, the last endorsement is Friday's, the day after the two thousand died in writing. "Nine o'clock," he says. "The books open at nine. The name is Monday's, not tonight's.")*
> *(Rose nods. The cost of the unknown is that the house must price a principal it cannot see, and the pricing is all the night has: the formed hand, the fresh purse, the changed orders. "We are weighing a woman by her handwriting," Henry says, "and her purse. It is more," he adds, "than the law usually gets." The draft, folded. The morning, tasked.)*

scenes.synopsis: the friend's courage — Octavia names what the principal's money costs Rose; the shape, spoken.
scenes.prose:
> *(Octavia waits till Henry has gone to the study, and then she says it the way she says everything that matters: plainly, and once. "She is spending the way your grandfather spent," she says. "Other people's patience, her own money, and no flinching. You know the shape of that hand, Rose, because you have held the pen yourself all season. The cost of it is not the money. The cost is what you have to become to hold it steady.")*
> *(Rose looks at her. "And what is that?" "Someone who doesn't flinch," Octavia says. "The question the night is asking is whether you can hold your hand as steady as hers, and what it costs you if you can." She picks up the memorandum book. "That is the weighing. The rest is arithmetic." The friend, plain. The cost, named.)*

scenes.synopsis: the heir, at half past twelve — the garden path; the gap; the card, still unwritten.
scenes.prose:
> *(At half past twelve he is still in the walled garden, the black coat, the hands in the pockets, the young man's back to the house. He has walked the path from the gap to the far wall and back a dozen times, and each time he stops at the gap where the papers came out, where his family's ruin got its name back. The card he may write in the morning's post is not written; tonight he is not deciding, only walking, the heir of a ruin doing the only thing the night permits.)*
> *(If she chose expose: his mother's name will be in every sheet by Monday, told true. If she chose bury: his mother's name stays out of the papers, and the keeping has its price. If she chose atone: the twelve hundred is debt, named and paying, and he is learning to be a creditor. Whatever the door, the walking is the same: spare, alone, his. She does not call to him. The garden, his. The heir, walking.)*

scenes.synopsis: the black coat, at night — the heir's undress; the garden, his dressing room.
scenes.prose:
> *(Laurent at half past twelve wears the night the way he wears everything: as if it were cut for him and he is deciding whether to keep it. The black coat, the collar up against the garden's chill, the cravat loosened, the hands in the pockets. No hat. The garden path is his dressing room, and the dressing is grief, worn spare: nothing extra, nothing shown, the heir undressed to the essential.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the essential is a name that will be read on Monday. If she chose bury: the essential is a name that stays unprinted. If she chose atone: the essential is £1,200 of debt, named. Whatever the door, the coat is the same: black, severe, his. The collar, up. The heir, undressed.)*

fashionChoices.detail: the back, turned; the grief, his own.

fashionChoices.label: Laurent, turned
fashionChoices.detail: the face, half-lit; the night, shared.

fashionChoices.label: Rose's eye
fashionChoices.detail: the mistress judges the heir.

scenes.synopsis: the work's inventory — Slade's second man's report; the reload's night shift, itemized.
scenes.prose:
> *(Slade's second man brings the inventory at half past twelve, and it is the reload's night shift itemized. The lodgings' three lamps, the men awake, the packet's receipt from Pounce's office on the table. The boy who carried the packet is back and paid. His wages are doubled and in his pocket. Slade's new instructions are on no paper anywhere, and everywhere in the room.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the work is the Monday special in type, the compositor's overtime, the accomplice's story set before the truth. If she chose bury: the work is the search's first prices asked, the mason's yard watched, the grandfather's letters priced. If she chose atone: the work is the smear's first line, the trust's forty-one thousand six hundred made to sound like hush money. In every door the inventory is the same: the watching over, the working staffed, the principal's money moving. The lamps, lit. The night, working.)*

scenes.synopsis: the quiet, seconded — Mrs. Quick's people, quiet still; the careful, continued.
scenes.prose:
> *(At half past twelve the village's quiet is the same quiet, seconded. Mrs. Pike's counter is dark, the shop blind down, the headache she never had still unmentioned. The Crown's taproom is shuttered, careful. The blacksmith's boy, asked again about the mason's hours, says nothing again, and this time he doesn't look away, which is worse. The village is not talking, and the not-talking has settled into its Sunday-night shape: decided, and holding.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the quiet is the hunters learning the account rides, and closing ranks. If she chose bury: the quiet is the hunters learning the papers are ash, and listening. If she chose atone: the quiet is the hunters learning the trust pays, and pricing the smear. Whatever the door, the quiet is the same: the eyes told to stop watching and start working, and the working done somewhere else. The village, dark. The quiet, kept.)*

scenes.synopsis: the witness, past midnight — Harrow's lamp; the guard's fire; the keeping, unbroken.
scenes.prose:
> *(She walks as far as the garden gate and looks down the path, the way she has looked all week. Harrow's lamp burns, the schoolmaster awake, or reading, or sitting with the papers that are his half of the sin. The guard's fire is lit in the lean-to, the second man's relief walking his round with the pipe glowing. Past midnight, and the keeping is unbroken: no one touches him, no one buys him, no one prints him.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the town will call him the accomplice for a week, and the guard is the house's answer. If she chose bury: the quiet is kept, and the guard is the quiet's price. If she chose atone: the deed is half fair-copied, and the guard is the deed's honor. Whatever the door, the light is the same: the witness, kept. She turns back to the house. The path, dark. The keeping, lit.)*

scenes.synopsis: the drive, at half past twelve — the second man; the lantern; the night, guarded.
scenes.prose:
> *(The second man walks the drive at half past twelve with the lantern trimmed, and the drive is empty all the way to the village. Nothing has come up it all night but the mason's cart, and nothing will till morning: the boy's return, or the third course at seven, or the trust's first accounting, whichever Monday brings. He walks it the way Amos walked it, steady, unhurried, a Hartwell man on Hartwell ground.)*
> *(Rose watches from the hall window as the lantern swings down the drive and back. Whatever the door, the account riding, the wall rising, the trust paying, the watch is the same: the night guarded into its small hours, the house asleep behind it. The lantern, swinging. The drive, held.)*

scenes.synopsis: the aunt, at quarter to one — the wrapper; the stairs; the crack, deepening, unconfessed.
scenes.prose:
> *(At quarter to one Letitia comes down the stairs, and the quartermaster's blacks are gone. She wears her wrapper, the grey wool, the hair down in its night plait, and she looks, for the first time in Rose's memory, like a woman instead of an office. "I can't sleep," she says. "The morning's orders — tell me the morning's orders, Rose. I want something to carry upstairs.")*
> *(Rose gives her the orders: the mason's men at seven, the kitchen door, the household book, the post. Letitia takes them the way she takes everything, as ballast. Then, at the stair's turn: "I kept the peace, Rose. Twenty years. I don't know that I kept anything else." She goes up without waiting for an answer. The confession, whatever it is, is not tonight's. The stairs, empty. The crack, deepening.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 2/3 — THE AUNT'S NIGHT: what Rose does with Letitia's widening crack at one o'clock.
scenes.prose:
> *(Quarter to one, and Letitia has gone upstairs in her wrapper with the morning's orders for ballast and "I don't know that I kept anything else" hanging in the stairwell. She knew the shape, never the names or sums, and the silence kept the family's peace for twenty years. Three answers offer themselves. Ask her now: go up, knock, sit on the bed's edge, and hear whatever comes, candor to the woman who kept the house, because the crack is at its widest and a crack met is a crack mended. Let her sleep: the night holds it, the confession keeps till its own hour, mercy to the aunt, because some silences are load-bearing and this one is holding up the whole house. Set her to morning: the orders given, the quartermaster's duty as the splint, the household needing its quartermaster, because Letitia has never once failed an order and the work will hold her till the hour comes.)*
> *(She stands at the stair's foot with the candle burning somewhere above her, and thinks: the choosing was the door, the hand was the reckoning, the aunt is the family. This is the night, inside all three.)*
> *(She chose for the aunt the way she had chosen for the hand: deliberately, and with love in hand. Whatever it was, the asking, the sleeping, the morning, Letitia would receive it the way she receives everything, as a question, or a mercy, or an order, and answer in kind. The aunt, answered.)*

options.label: Ask her now
options.detail: *Candor+; the question, asked.* Go up; knock; hear it. *(The crack, met before it breaks.)*

options.label: Let her sleep
options.detail: *Mercy+; the silence, honored.* The night holds it; the hour, hers. *(The house stands; the confession, kept.)*

options.label: Set her to morning
options.detail: *Resolve+; the quartermaster, kept.* The orders; duty as the splint. *(She has never failed an order.)*

scenes.synopsis: the third hour of the labor — stone, road, or pen; the choosing, carried into the small hours.
scenes.prose:
> *(The night's labor goes into its third hour. If she chose bury: the mason's men are readied for seven, the third course, the kitchen door, the men's breakfast ordered. If she chose expose: the road to town lies dark, and the boy is still out, the sealed account riding somewhere between the Park and the proprietor's desk. If she chose atone: the trust's first letters wait for the morning's post, the creditors' names, the seal's red wax on the founding's copies, the clerk asleep over the half fair-copied deed.)*
> *(Rose stands at the hall window and watches the labor she cannot see being done by other hands. The choosing, carried. The night, laboring.)*

scenes.synopsis: the evidence, at one — Henry's drawer; the week's paper, ordered for morning.
scenes.prose:
> *(In the study at one o'clock Henry's evidence drawer lies open under the lamp, and the week's paper is all in order for the morning: Slade's first letter, the two thousand, offered Thursday, refused in writing by nightfall; the refusal, in Rose's hand; the draft from the factor, new tonight, on top, its back read twice and its last coat hanging in a counting-house that opens at nine.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the drawer holds the account's fair copy, the boy's errand, the seal's press. If she chose bury: the drawer holds the ash's record, the burning witnessed, the wall's order. If she chose atone: the drawer holds the trust's founding, sealed, the first payment entered. Whatever the door, the drawer is the same: the week's truth, filed. The evidence, kept.)*

scenes.synopsis: the weighing, together — the principal's intent priced three ways; the signature, unknown; the intent, priced.
scenes.prose:
> *(At one o'clock the three of them stand in the morning room, and the weighing is done together the way the choosing was: deliberately, and once. Octavia's arithmetic: the purse is fresh, the patience is spent, "no more waiting" is a budget, and the principal has decided the waiting costs more than the doing. Henry's law: the letter is burned, the orders are paperless, the denial is the plan, and a principal who buys hands instead of outcomes means to finish it. Rose's doctrine: the hand is a woman's, formed and unhurried, and she knows the shape of that hand because she has held the pen herself.)*
> *(The signature is unknown. The contents are unknown. The intent is priced, three ways, and the three ways agree: she is done waiting, she is buying the morning, and whatever Monday costs, it will not cost the waiting. They stand a moment in the lamplight, three people who have weighed a woman by her handwriting and her purse. The weighing, done. The night, answered.)*

scenes.synopsis: the brother's night — Henry's bag, packed; the trace, dressed for the morning coach.
scenes.prose:
> *(Henry at one o'clock is the brother undressed to the essential: the coat off, the sleeves turned back, the bag packed for the morning coach, the factor's direction copied fair and folded into the breast pocket. His cravat is still tied. Some men undress by halves, and Henry is one of them: the bag ready, the man half-ready, the trace's dress laid out the way other men lay out court clothes.)*
> *(If she chose expose: the bag carries the trace that would name whose money buys the gutter's Monday special. If she chose bury: the trace that would name whose money buys the search. If she chose atone: the trace that would name whose money buys the smear. Whatever the door, the packing is the same: the money will name the wearer, and the name is the weapon. The bag, packed. The brother, half-undressed.)*

fashionChoices.detail: the bag, packed; the morning, faced.

fashionChoices.label: Henry, rumpled
fashionChoices.detail: the sleeves, turned; the hour, worked.
